children: Gold futures are lower as the U.S. dollar gains amid higher U.S. interest-rate expectations. "The near-term setup for gold remains challenging," Kaynat Chainwala of Kotak Neo says in a note. "A dollar holding above 100 and October hike odds above 50% represent a structurally negative combination for non-yielding assets, and further hawkish signals ahead of the October meeting could extend the current pressure." Gold for December delivery is off 1.4% in New York at $4,315.20 a troy ounce. Silver is down 2.2% at $65.04 a troy ounce. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
